_: Copy this to power.json and edit it. Nothing here is read unless
_1: power.json exists -- smart-plug support is OFF by default, and an
_2: installer never ships a live power.json. Keys beginning with _ are
_3: ignored, so they can be used as comments in a format that has none.
_model: shelly | shelly-gen1 | tasmota | kasa | homeassistant | http
_model_note: Only 'shelly' (Gen2/3/4 RPC) has been tested on real hardware.
_host: IP or hostname of the PLUG -- not of the DOS box.
_channel: Which relay on a multi-outlet device. 0 for a single plug.
_auth: Only if the plug requires it. Shelly Gen2+ uses digest auth.
_off_secs: How long to hold the power off. Do not go below ~4: PSU
_off_secs2: capacitors keep a small machine alive briefly, and a cycle
_off_secs3: the hardware never noticed still looks like it worked.
_limits: The guards. A recovery that can loop is worse than none: a box
_limits2: that will not come back for a reason power cannot fix would
_limits3: otherwise be cut every couple of minutes, forever, with nobody
_limits4: watching. Counted in power.state so they survive a re-run.
_max_cycles: Hard ceiling per window. --force does NOT override this.
_min_interval: Refuse a second cycle sooner than this. --force overrides.
_auto: Let dosctl power-cycle by itself when the box fails to come back
_auto2: from a reboot or an upgrade. false = manual `dosctl power` only.
_ha: homeassistant only: a long-lived token and the entity to switch.
_http: http driver only: your own URLs. status_url is optional; without
_http2: it the state reads as unknown and a cycle proceeds blind.
